title: The Twin Way Canon
summary: A canon of two Ways walked as one so that each yields to the other and the foe finds no gap between them.

title: Treatise of the Azure Accord
summary: A treatise on the calm accord of the open sky that heals the wounded and lets the user pass where nothing is closed.

title: The Basin Mastery of the Level Path
summary: A mastery of the Level Path in which all qi settles flat like water in a basin and nothing rises to be struck.

title: The Plateau Way Canon
summary: A canon of the Way walked over an open plateau where the user is anywhere and nowhere in a breath.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Sworn Law
summary: A treatise on an oath to keep faith with natural law whose strikes cannot be countered by anything outside it.

title: The Windward Path Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of a path that runs before the wind and bends nothing in its way as it passes and mends what it touches.
